description: Store a fact or preference about a user. Smara handles deduplication and contradiction detection automatically. Use importance 0.1-0.3 for trivia, 0.5 for general facts, 0.7-1.0 for critical preferences.

fact.description: The fact or preference to remember

namespace.description: Memory namespace for isolation (default: from env or 'default')

team_id.description: Team ID to store this memory under. Defaults to SMARA_TEAM_ID env var if set.

visibility.description: Who can see this memory. Use 'team' for project decisions, architecture, conventions, shared knowledge — anything a teammate needs. Use 'private' for personal preferences, editor settings, individual style choices. Only applies when SMARA_TEAM_ID is set.

name: store_memory
title: Store Memory
